title: Odile and the Orbit Revisited
author: Yara Nystrom
blurb: Ansel Okafor, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
